games.title: Composer's Choice
games.skillName: Choosing tempo, dynamics and pitch for a purpose
games.statutoryRequirement: Pupils should be taught to improvise and compose music for a range of purposes using the inter-related dimensions of music
games.instruction: Think about the purpose of the music, then tap the best choice.
games.hint: Not quite. Imagine how the scene feels, then try again.

questions.ask: You are composing a lullaby. Which tempo suits it?
Music for an exciting chase scene needs which tempo?
Which dynamic suits a lullaby best?
Music for a giant's footsteps should use which pitch?
Music for twinkling stars suits which pitch?
To show a monster creeping nearer, which would you use?
To show a train slowing down to stop, which would you use?
Which choice sounds happiest for a party song?
Which choice suits music for a spooky cave?
What is a short pattern repeated under your piece called?

games.title: World Music Passport
games.skillName: Music from different traditions and great musicians
games.statutoryRequirement: Pupils should be taught to appreciate and understand a wide range of high-quality live and recorded music drawn from different traditions and from great composers and musicians
games.instruction: Read the clues, then tap the music or musician.
games.hint: Not quite. Think about which country the clues point to, then try again.

questions.ask: Bronze gongs and metallophones played together in Indonesia. What am I?
Loud carnival street music from Brazil with big surdo drums. What am I?
Off-beat guitar chops from Jamaica, made famous by Bob Marley. What am I?
Songs of hard times from the American South, often 12 bars long. What am I?
Born in New Orleans, my players often make up solos on the spot. What am I?
Songs from Hindi films made in Mumbai, often with big dances. What am I?
A goblet-shaped West African drum played with bare hands. What am I?
A New Orleans jazz trumpeter and singer nicknamed Satchmo. Who am I?
An Indian sitar player who taught George Harrison of The Beatles. Who am I?
A Jamaican reggae singer who sang "Three Little Birds". Who am I?
